observations: The page number «XVIII» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01-L02 end the marginal note of fol. 9r begun on p. XVII (JP2 0021, L38-L40).

L02 and L17: «(?)», upright, after a gap of 10 px from the italic word before it (a thin space, as before the colons); L21 «(sic)» upright. L03: the omission in the quotation is printed as three points about 18 px apart, as on p. XI (JP2 0015, L09); transcribed «. . .». L26: the dash of «9—20» is printed in two pieces, as on p. XI; transcribed as one long dash. N05: «XXXIV–XXXV» has a short dash (30 px), where N02 «1825—26» and «426—430» have the long dash (41 px).
L32-L34: the seconds and minutes of arc are printed with the double and single prime, «18″», «4′ 49″»; L29, L36, L37: the h of the hours raised, «5h», «4h».
Marks not transcribed: a small comma-shaped speck above the B of «Bekanntlich» (L06) and a light speck above «dicta» (L03).
copy_matter: A vertical stroke of pencil, about 25 px wide and 330 px long, in the right margin beside L21-L26. Not part of the edition.
